hypothesis: The neuron responds strongly to monochromatic, grayscale images featuring a distinct, dark central object—typically deep black or dark charcoal—positioned against a lighter, often textured background of pale to medium gray. The activating feature usually takes the form of a compact, high-contrast silhouette or spot, such as an insect (spider, tick, butterfly), a small animal (bird head, wallaby), or a geometric void (slot, hole), characterized by a stark dark-on-light polarity. The neuron remains invariant to the object's specific identity, surface texture (whether organic fur/exoskeleton or inorganic metal/stone), and background pattern, provided the grayscale palette and sharp figure-ground separation are maintained. The dark feature typically occupies 10–30% of the image area and is consistently aligned with the geometric center of the frame.

Her eyes are heavy-lidded and gaze slightly upward and to the right, while her nose is straight and her mouth is small and closed. A soft shadow is cast on the right side of her face and neck, suggesting a light source from the upper left. She wears a high, ruffled collar and a dark mantle draped over her shoulders, which is heavily embroidered with thick, light-gray scrolling arabesque or acanthus leaf designs in raised relief. Beneath the mantle, a bodice with vertical piping and a central medallion or pendant is visible. In her left hand, positioned at the lower right of the figure, she holds a dark, clustered object that resembles a flower or scepter, though it is slightly out of focus. The background consists of out-of-focus architectural elements in light gray stone; on the left, a vertical fluted column or pilaster runs from top to bottom, while on the right, an arched niche contains a smaller, standing statue of a robed figure, appearing to be a male saint holding an object. Below this niche, partially obscured at the bottom right edge, the capital letters "JAN" are visible on a flat stone surface. One hand is oriented perfectly vertically, bisecting the face from top to bottom; its upper tip terminates in a stylized arrowhead pointing towards the twelve o'clock position, while its lower tail ends in an upward-facing crescent moon shape near the six o'clock position. Numerical values are positioned just inside this track: "29" in the upper-left quadrant, "30" in the upper-right, "28" at the nine o'clock position, "27" in the lower-left, and "26" in the lower-right measurement area. Along the right-hand edge, outside the numbered scale and running vertically near the "30" and "31" marks, the words "VERY DRY" are printed in capital serif letters. At the bottom of the dial, curving upwards to match the circular rim, the faint text "ANEROID BAROMETER" is visible, with "ANEROID" to the left of the vertical hand's tail and "BAROMETER" to the right. The lighting is diffuse and soft, resulting in a slightly grainy texture, with the darkest values found in the hands and the central pivot.
